p: gate: In the place where wisdom should be shown.
faintest in the day of adversity: Man has no trial of his strength till he is in trouble.
death: No one can be excused, if he does not help the innocent when he is in danger.
honey: As honey is sweet and pleasant to the taste, so wisdom is to the soul.
falleth seven times: He is subject to many perils, but God delivers him.
from him: To be avenged on you.
both: Meaning, either of the wicked and seditious, as in Pr 24:19,21 or of them who do not fear God or obey their king.
and afterwards build thy house: Be sure of the means how to compass it, before you take any enterprise in hand.
will render to the man according: He shows what is the nature of the wicked, to revenge wrong for wrong.
instruction: That I might learn by another man's fault.
